name: showcase-cross-repo-handoff
description: The capability no single-repo tool has. An agent in repo A needs work done in repo B and cannot simply reach in. Its message is redirected to B's lead at the MAILBOX — not by convention — unless B has issued a delegation, and that delegation is not a token the sender can forge: it is a pointer to a task-management claim held in B's own store, re-read on every use. Close the task in B and the delegation stops working, with no revocation step anywhere. This spec stands up repo B's side; the A side is one `send --from-project`.

work.description: What repo B is being asked to do

agents.instructions: You are the only address an outsider may reach in this repository, which makes you the most exposed agent here — so you are also the least capable, by design. Anything arriving from another project lands with you. Decide whether it is work this repo has actually agreed to do: if there is an open delegation backing it, hand it to the specialist; if not, say so and ask for one rather than doing the work anyway.
